summary: Full frontend regression of Actalink multi-page site: routing (/, /blogs, /blogs/:slug, /about-us), navbar (logo + Home/Products/Blog + Get in touch), blog preview section on landing, blog list with 5 posts, blog post rendering with More articles, About us page (hero, stats, CTA), footer (Products/Resources/Social columns, external link hrefs & target=_blank, no Company column), scroll-to-top on route change, and 390px responsiveness. 45/45 checks passed with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Footer 'Privacy' and 'Terms' anchor to '#footer' — dead links; consider real routes or removing.
Minor: Navbar goSection uses setTimeout(200ms) after navigate, which is timing-fragile; consider triggering scroll via useEffect on landing mount with location.state.
Minor: BlogPost article-not-found path lacks a data-testid on the back button for automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routing, navbar, blog list/post, about-us, footer external link attributes, scroll reset, and mobile-390 overflow checks pass. No backend involved.
